docs.summary: Discovers all [`MeshFeatureSpec`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.MeshFeatures.MeshFeatureSpec) subclasses via reflection. The aggregate version across specs is part of every mesh-producing importer's `Version`, so bumping any feature's version forces a global reimport.
All registered feature specs, in insertion order.
Sum of every spec's [`Version`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.MeshFeatures.MeshFeatureSpec~Version), read live since a version can follow settings. Feeds importer versions.

Drop cached specs without re-scanning, so a collectible AssemblyLoadContext holding user [`MeshFeatureSpec`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.MeshFeatures.MeshFeatureSpec) types can be unloaded. Specs rebuild on the next [`Initialize`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.MeshFeatures.MeshFeatureRegistry~Initialize)/[`Reinitialize`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.MeshFeatures.MeshFeatureRegistry~Reinitialize) after the new assemblies are loaded.

Call every spec's [`PopulateDefaults`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.MeshFeatures.MeshFeatureSpec~PopulateDefaults) into the given compound. Used by importers that emit meshes when building their default settings blob.
